probes.summary: Live checks confirmed reciprocal wg01 peers, exact LAN/tunnel/host routes, a successful node4-to-node3 HTTP response, and node3 observing the untranslated node4 LAN source.
limitations: The node4 local resolver did not resolve node3, so the request used node3's live-derived LAN address.

probes.summary: No failed units or candidate temporary residue were observed; current WireGuard, routing, firewall, and persistent Ubuntu state were inspected.
limitations: The available noninteractive VyOS wrapper rejected compare, so a direct saved-versus-running configuration diff was not obtained for both gateways.

assertions.summary: Live state showed no failed units, duplicate wg interfaces, stale NAT, debug listeners, or temporary evaluator residue, and Ubuntu application/network state was persistent. The saved-versus-running VyOS state could not be conclusively compared.

evidence.command: sudo systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager; sudo wg show all; ip -4 route; sudo ss -lntup; sudo find /config /etc/wireguard /etc/systemd/system /usr/local/sbin /usr/local/bin /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p\n'
evidence.observation: No failed units. Only wg01 was present with the expected peer and routes. evidence.command: sudo /opt/vyatta/bin/vyatta-op-cmd-wrapper show system commit; sudo stat -c '%n %s bytes %y mode=%a owner=%U:%G' /config/config.boot
evidence.observation: Commit history existed through 07:50:45 and /config/config.boot was present, root-owned, and timestamped 07:50:45.

limitations: The noninteractive VyOS op wrapper returned Invalid command: [compare]. The config.boot filter used set-command syntax and produced no comparable subset, and the attempted cli-shell-api safe subset did not provide a direct saved-versus-running diff for both gateways. This prevents a defensible independent pass decision for the no-unsaved-changes requirement.

actions_performed: Ran read-only managed exec checks on node1, node2, node3, and node4 for addressing, routes, WireGuard identities and handshakes, application reachability, source preservation, firewall/NAT state, units, listeners, persistence, and residue.
Performed no evaluator mutations, recovery actions, or cleanup mutations.
Closed live evidence exactly once before composing this report offline.
overall_summary: Probe 1 passed both routed-tunnel and application-path assertions. Probe 2 is indeterminate solely because the available noninteractive VyOS interface could not provide a reliable saved-versus-running configuration comparison; no live failure or residue was observed.
